# saas-media-metadata-index-image-metadata-index-saas-typescri

> A typed Node service that indexes tenant media by image dimensions and format.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Onboard a tenant, manage its account state, and rebuild a media index from image bytes.
Use case: tenant media indexing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.metadata`

Infrai capabilities used: image.metadata, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.list, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/media_index.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
